allocation: 32 matched quartets, 8 per category; original A/B random assignments preserved; C and later D matched by Oracle complexity
acceptance: All applicable nonintrinsic abilities fire and whole-ability mutants are killed
Codegen and relevant repository gates pass
metrics: Input, cached input, uncached input and output tokens by agent/model/arm
Authoring, planning, repair and review costs included
Accepted cards and tokens per accepted card
Production defects separated from author defects
Wall time per stage; concurrent scheduling disclosed
limits: Whole-ability mutation does not prove complete clause coverage
Different matched cards are not identical tasks
Single experiment does not establish a universal winner
Telemetry is best-effort and not a bill
No hypothetical dollar savings inferred without applicable rates
Agent-work duration sums overlapping agent turns; it is not isolated wall-clock runtime.
Arm D starts later with warm build caches; compare model work and quality separately from build duration.
Tokens are measurable per agent turn, not reliably per individual card in a 16-card batch.

deviations.event: Broad rg exposed approximately20 lines of paired A Lightning Strike target/player damage test; no target implementation read; author stopped and disclosed. Retain measured cost and exclude entire spells-04 triple in sensitivity analysis.
Coordinator supplied unqualified fixture index path; one subsequent compile failure and qualification repair counted as shared coordination, not author quality.
D registration introduced one doc_markdown lint in a new parent registry; corrected by shared integrator, not charged as author defect.

production_gaps.handling: Keep useful supported-category tests; never assert marked damage as correct battle behavior; no fullyImplemented promotion; separate author quality from production defect.

review.closure_evidence: 66–110 resolves destruction of Elf, Sol Ring, Luminarch Ascension and Jace into opponent owner graveyard. 114–201 separately rejects six-mana and real-Twiddle-tapped seven-mana source.

cards.matching_rationale: Flash artifact with mana/tap/self-sacrifice; destroys permanent instead of damage

cards.name: Greenseeker

review.covered_evidence: Green mana spent, source tapped, chosen card discarded; library search chooses land into hand and reduces library one.
review.closure_evidence: 24–27 mixed library has basic Island, nonbasic Riptide Laboratory, nonland Bolt; 65–90 filters, exact destination, selected reveal and shuffle event. 94–177 independently rejects no discard, wrong-color mana, real-tapped source with green mana and discard retained.

cards.matching_rationale: Same basic search/reveal/hand/shuffle; adds colored mana, tap and discard cost in place of self-sacrifice

cards.name: Spock, Logical Choice

review.covered_evidence: Actual attack leaves Spock untapped while elf taps; subsequent activation taps Spock and draws exactly one.
review.closure_evidence: 45–55 rejects repeat tapped activation with nonempty library; 59–82 real fresh cast rejects tap activation while preserving untapped state.

cards.matching_rationale: Tap draws one with no mana cost; separate vigilance clause adds operational keyword check

cards.name: Tidepool Turtle

review.covered_evidence: Two paid activations exercise top/bottom answers; one-card scry prompt, unchanged library size, no tap.
review.closure_evidence: 49–63 exact inspected ObjectId becomes library first for bottom or last for top (zone module documents top=end); 69–91 independently checks wrong color and two-mana cost failures.

cards.matching_rationale: Small scry activation with colored mana and no tap cost

cards.name: Facet Reader

review.covered_evidence: One mana and tap paid; draw precedes discard prompt; selected card discarded; exact library and hand deltas.
review.closure_evidence: 61–80 rejects zero-mana activation; 82–116 real Twiddle leaves source tapped and one mana floating; activation refused and mana retained.

cards.matching_rationale: Tap draw then discard one with additional generic mana

cards.name: Abzan Banner

review.covered_evidence: W/B/G mana alternatives each resolve immediately for one; second activation spends WBG, sacrifices and draws one.
review.closure_evidence: 30–41 rejects repeated tap mana activation; 68–91 three-mana WBB rejects WBG draw; 93–130 real Twiddle consumes blue, leaves WBG and tapped source, draw rejected without mutation.

cards.matching_rationale: Same three-color tap mana ability plus extra colored-mana/tap/sacrifice draw ability

cards.name: Mana Geode

review.covered_evidence: Real entry issues one-card scry prompt; bottom answer accepted; red mana activation taps source and adds red immediately.
review.closure_evidence: 13–88 resolves all five mana colors for exactly one total mana, alternating exact top/bottom ObjectId scry placement, and rejects repeated tapped mana activation.

cards.matching_rationale: Any-color tap mana ability plus entry scry one

cards.name: Ferocity of the Wilds

review.covered_evidence: Actual own non-Human attack gains +1/+0 and trample; attacking Human and idle non-Human excluded.
review.closure_evidence: 50–54 own ending phase verifies attack-only modifier expires; 55–68 actual opposing non-Human attack remains 1/1 without trample.

cards.matching_rationale: Own attacking creature power bonus with extra non-Human restriction and trample

cards.name: Megantic Sliver

review.covered_evidence: Own source pumps itself +3/+3; second real cast stacks to +6/+6; opponent source does not receive own boosts; non-Sliver unchanged.
review.closure_evidence: 46–62 real opposing Unsummon removes second friendly source; remaining own and opposing sources correctly 6/6, returned source in owner hand.

cards.matching_rationale: Own tribe anthem; includes source and larger numeric bonus

cards.name: Adept Watershaper

review.covered_evidence: Real own elf mana tap turns projected indestructible on; untapped friend excluded.
review.closure_evidence: 41–60 real Twiddle taps source and opposing Elf, both excluded; 61–71 real Doom Blade fails to destroy protected own Elf; 72–75 next own main untaps Elf and removes keyword.

cards.matching_rationale: Other own tapped creatures gain indestructible versus untapped-conditioned group stats

cards.name: Foundry Screecher

review.covered_evidence: Opposing artifact alone gives no power; casting own artifact gives exactly +1/+0; flying projected.
review.closure_evidence: 22–31 real cast verifies flying and own artifact power increase; 32–46 real opposing Nature’s Claim removes own artifact while opposing Sol Ring remains, returning power to 2/1.

cards.matching_rationale: Self artifact-conditioned power bonus plus separate flying

cards.name: Woolly Mammoths

review.covered_evidence: Opposing snow and own ordinary land give no trample; playing own snow land turns projected trample on.
review.closure_evidence: 31–40 real cast and snow land play exercise projected keyword; 41–55 next own main Stone Rain destroys own snow land, opposing snow remains, trample disappears.

cards.matching_rationale: Self combat keyword conditional on controlled land characteristic

cards.name: Nylea's Forerunner

review.covered_evidence: Real cast grants other own creature trample; source has trample; opponent excluded; P/T unchanged.
review.closure_evidence: 42–53 real opposing Unsummon removes source into owner hand; other own creature loses trample.

cards.matching_rationale: Self trample plus other own creatures gain trample

cards.name: Oathsworn Giant

review.covered_evidence: Real cast grants other own creature +0/+2 and vigilance; source excluded from toughness; opponent excluded.
review.closure_evidence: 45–57 real opposing Unsummon removes source into owner hand; other own creature returns to 1/1 and loses vigilance.

cards.matching_rationale: Self vigilance plus other own creatures gain toughness and vigilance; no tribe filter

cards.name: Blur Sliver

review.covered_evidence: Real cast grants projected haste to source and own Sliver; non-Sliver and opponent excluded; source offered as attacker.
review.closure_evidence: 35–50 source and allied Metallic Sliver freshly cast alongside fresh Human without haste; 57–68 fresh Human excluded and both fresh Slivers actually declared attacking and tap.

cards.matching_rationale: Own Slivers gain one combat keyword, including source
